summaryZh: Winkielman社会认知实验室研究情绪、认知、具身体验与意识的相互作用及其对人类社会认知的影响。它使用社会与认知心理学方法，并结合心理生理学和社会神经科学技术。
researchQuestions: 情绪、认知、具身体验与意识如何共同影响社会认知？
methods: 社会与认知心理学方法

evidence.quote: Our research explores the interplay between emotion, cognition, embodiment and consciousness. We are particularly interested in the implications of these processes for understanding human social cognition. Our work uses diverse methods of social and cognitive psychology, including techniques from psychophysiology and social neuroscience.
